notes: All 7 web searches ran (the 6 required plus one on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors); none returned any statement by Andy Ogles about AI. Results on extinction and China instead mentioned other people named Andy (Rep. Andy Barr, Sen. Andy Kim, an unnamed podcast guest); none of their words were attributed to Ogles. The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Rep. Casar) is reported to have about 9-10 cosponsors, all named ones Democrats (e.g. Ocasio-Cortez, Hoyle, Lynch, Tonko); Ogles is not named in any source, but the official cosponsor page on congress.gov returned 403 and could not be opened, so the full list was not confirmed. Official site: an earlier run opened the press release listing pages (https://ogles.house.gov/media/press-releases, ?page=1, ?page=2), covering 30 releases from 19 August 2025 to 23 July 2026, and found none about AI; this run reopened the first page and confirmed the same releases (latest 23 July 2026) with no AI mention. The site search surfaced his 16 January 2026 cyber offensive hearing release and his 18 November 2025 appointment as chair of the House Homeland Security cybersecurity subcommittee, which mentions only 'emerging technological threats'; neither mentions AI. Releases on pages 3 and later of the listing (before August 2025) were not opened.
